research_lifecycle.reason: Background-process lifecycle semantics and personal cluster/GPU resource ROI
research_lifecycle.historical_gate_scope: Preserve original qualified/partial/pending outcomes; exploratory N8/16MiB L0 Tier-1 is recorded separately in pre-v3 qualification.

dataset_use_case_qualification.requirement: Qualified tool/model waits and safety semantics, family-isolated temporal splits, complete selection denominators for the intended scheduling workload.

native_capture_integrity.requirement: Complete PostgreSQL Coordinator admission demand, capacity-rejection/retry, CreateActor/ResumeActor RPC, ready and release chains; restart recovery, runtime receipts and cross-producer identities on the target MEMORY runtime, with measured capture overhead. Historical FairSlots captures retain their legacy runner-admission scope.

physical_cost_calibration.requirement: Target-environment MEMORY lifecycle, RSS/charge and device I/O, failures and concurrency; held-out calibration error against frozen tolerance.

closed_loop_DAG_validation.requirement: Live-runner parent delay, joins, restore queue propagation, terminal-turn sensitivity and runtime calibration.

complete_online_feature_lineage.requirement: Each deployed decision input has producer, available_at, consumer, source frontier and training cutoff; restored runtime identity is issued externally.

independent_statistical_design.requirement: Frozen primary metrics, complete planned/offered denominators, family/time holdout, paired runner units across multiple independent seeds, failure treatment and calibration tolerance.

event_distribution_and_family_time_split.requirement: Event-level wait and tool distributions for AgentLogs and FreeInference, with family-isolated temporal splits and frozen source hashes; freeze primary and independent-validation roles after event qualification.

stratified_memory_costs.requirement: Real Substrate MEMORY measurements for every frozen heap/concurrency coordinate: sample counts, checkpoint/resume p50 and p95, physical RSS, memory charge, physical snapshot write bytes and filesystem used-space watermark. Each metric identifies its collector and raw-table column; independent raw and fitted tables have verified SHA256, and the fitted table cites its raw source hash.

native_queue_without_polling_noise.requirement: Native admission wakes from capacity-release events with bounded fallback retry. Independently qualify measured release-to-eligible-attempt p95/max latency, fallback-attempt fraction, and bounded eligible wait by tenant against budgets frozen before the new runtime validation.
